verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's pricing page lists "Exportable audit logs" as a feature of its top (Enterprise-level) tier, and the docs describe draft feature revisions with review and approval before publishing, which suggests changes are tracked. The evidence is only a pricing bullet plus revision workflows, and the audit log appears gated to the highest plan. Missing for 10: documentation of what the audit log records per flag change (actor, timestamp, before/after values), confirmation that every flag change is captured, availability on lower tiers or self-hosted, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
